summary: This is a routine annual meeting notice and management proxy circular filed on Form 6-K by Canadian issuer Quantum eMotion Corp. The filing sets forth standard agenda items: receiving audited financials, electing directors, appointing auditors, and approving an amendment to the stock option plan (converting to a 10% rolling plan). There are no merger, acquisition, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, restructuring, or other special-situation elements. The document is a routine governance and proxy solicitation, not a special event.
